Great to watch this entire interview with @LucidMotors Corey @CorySteuben as a way to further that tradition! 👏


Tesla Owners Silicon Valley (@teslaownersSV)

.@LucidMotors Future Revealed: Cosmos, Earth, Lunar & Robotaxis  

We sat down with Cory Steuben
@CorySteuben, Director of Cost Engineering at Lucid, for a deep dive into Lucid’s next chapter, including Cosmos, Earth, Lunar, the midsize platform, and robotaxis.  

In this interview, Cory shares an inside look at Lucid’s upcoming platforms and long-term vision — from new vehicle programs to the role of robotaxis in their strategy. 

We discuss how cost engineering fits into the bigger picture as Lucid pushes forward in a competitive EV landscape.  

Whether you follow Lucid closely, are curious about their next moves, or just enjoy thoughtful conversations about the future of electric vehicles and autonomy, this one delivers real insight.  

📷 Watch the full interview below. Enjoy!

@DavidMoss, @DevinOlsenn, and @Scotsrule08 are proud to announce that we have successfully completed the world’s first Canada coast to coast fully autonomous drive!

We left Horseshoe Bay Terminal in Vancouver. BC 4 days & 21 hours ago, and now have ended in Halifax, NS at the Tesla Showroom

(3,760miles/6,051km)

This was accomplished with Tesla FSD v14.3.3 with absolutely 0 disengagements of any kind even for all parking including at Tesla Superchargers.
